hook: Drag a target line to any number, like 1 million, and logarithms tell you exactly when a spreading rumor or outbreak gets there, worked in base 2, base 10 and base e, all landing on the same answer.
outcome: Solve exponential models for time with logarithms in base 2, 10 and e, read percent growth from an exponential, and see where a pure exponential model breaks
sources: OpenStax, Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, sections 6.5 to 6.7: logarithmic properties, exponential and logarithmic equations, exponential and logarithmic models (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/details/books/algebra-and-trigonometry-2e
Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, High School Functions (F-LE.A.4, F-IF.C.8b, F-IF.C.9): https://www.thecorestandards.org/Math/Content/HSF/
US Census Bureau, 2020 Census, QuickFacts: Denver 715,522 and Colorado 5,773,714 (April 1, 2020): https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/
US Census Bureau, 2020 Census apportionment results: United States 331,449,281 (April 1, 2020): https://www.census.gov/data/tables/2020/dec/2020-apportionment-data.html
United Nations, Day of Eight Billion (November 15, 2022): https://www.un.org/en/dayof8billion
All stories are invented round numbers, labeled as made-up examples in the tool; worked answers computed from the formulas (checked 2026-10-25)
Graph, lines, shading, counter and cards drawn in code; sounds generated in the browser
Narration generated with Qwen3-TTS (Apache 2.0), cloning a Google Gemini text-to-speech voice
